_comment: Windows Task Scheduler jobs registered by ops/install.ps1 on EVERY PC that runs the dashboard. Each script is launched hidden through ops/silent-ps.vbs. Jobs with a role self-skip unless ops/hosts.json assigns that role to the PC, so changing the operator never needs a re-install.

tasks.name: ReverentDashboard-KeepAlive
tasks.description: Restart serve.ps1 (localhost:8000) if it is down. Every 5 min + at logon.

tasks.name: ReverentDashboard-RepoSync
tasks.description: Pull other PCs' commits and push local user-state edits. Every 5 min.

tasks.name: ReverentDashboard-DailyDeploy
tasks.description: Daily 07:00 snapshot (market + calendar + indexes) -> commit + push -> GitHub Pages.

tasks.name: ReverentDashboard-FridayDeploy
tasks.description: Friday 16:30 KR-close snapshot (capmkt + peer + IPO) -> commit + push.

tasks.name: ReverentDashboard-USClose
tasks.description: Saturday 06:30 KST US-close snapshot -> commit + push. Skips unless ops/hosts.json assigns us-close.
